name: BMAL1:CLOCK activation and CRY:PER repression of clock genes
rationale: All members describe the core clock transcriptional feedback loop (BMAL1:CLOCK activation, its modification, CRY:PER repression), whereas the confusables add glucocorticoid, gluconeogenic, PPAR/ROR-REV-ERB or NPAS outputs.

name: Somite specification and rostrocaudal compartment patterning
rationale: Members all concern somite formation and rostral/caudal compartment specification (including LFNG-defective spondylocostal dysostosis), lacking the Notch O-glycosylation, axis elongation or neural plate/hindbrain patterning of the confusables.

name: Inflammatory cytokine response with negative regulation of MCP-1
rationale: Members share the proinflammatory cytokine/chemokine response and include restraint of MCP-1 production, whereas confusables carry positive MCP-1/monocyte chemotaxis, chemokine-receptor or myeloid NFkB activation modules.

name: Deoxyribonucleotide metabolism with nucleotide and deoxynucleoside catabolism
rationale: Members centre on deoxyribonucleotide and nucleoside monophosphate breakdown (dGMP, dUMP, dTMP, UMP catabolism, ADA/PNP deoxynucleoside defects), whereas confusables emphasise de novo synthesis, salvage and di/triphosphate interconversion.

core: Sex determination and reproductive tract development
name: Sex determination, gonad and genital tract development
rationale: Members cover male sex determination, testis/Leydig differentiation, AMH signalling and genital, uterine, oviduct and vaginal development, unlike confusables focused on prostate, mammary gland or germ/Sertoli cells.

name: Apoptotic execution-phase nuclear dismantling and PAK-2p34 signaling
rationale: Members describe late apoptotic events (DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation, lamina breakdown) plus PAK-2p34 regulation, distinct from the confusables' autophagic, necroptotic or mitochondrial intrinsic apoptosis pathways.

qualifier: polarity, membrane raft and second messenger signalling
name: T cell immunological synapse, polarity and raft signaling
rationale: Members share T cell synapse assembly, polarity, aggregation, raft localization and second messenger generation (CORO1A-DEF6, Nef), while confusables add surface signatures, PECAM1 docking, Vav1 or RHO GTPase effectors.

name: Protein glycosylation and nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport
rationale: Members span N- and O-glycan elaboration, sialylation, fucosylation and the synthesis and Golgi transport of nucleotide sugars (with their CDG defects), whereas confusables centre on glycosphingolipids, ER N-glycan trimming, lysosomal glycan catabolism or sulfation.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase and cytokine receptor signaling
qualifier: ALK, FGFR, PDGFR mutants and erythropoietin-STAT5
name: Oncogenic ALK, FGFR, PDGFR mutants and erythropoietin-STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members share constitutive kinase signalling by oncogenic ALK, FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3 and LTK variants together with EPO/TPO/IL-3 STAT5 signalling, whereas confusables are dominated by FLT3, KIT and ERBB2 drug-resistance mutants.

name: PPARG-driven white adipocyte differentiation and adipose development
rationale: Members all promote white fat cell differentiation, proliferation and adipose development via PPARG, unlike confusables carrying negative regulation of adipogenesis, PGC-1alpha/PPARA or LXR lipid metabolism.

qualifier: replication stress, crosslink repair and recombination resolution
name: Replication-stress DNA repair, crosslink repair and recombination resolution
rationale: Members concern repair at stalled replication forks (fork reversal, ICL/Fanconi repair, BIR, SDSA, strand invasion, responses to crosslinking and topoisomerase drugs), while confusables centre on DSB sensing, NHEJ, BRCA1/2 defects or ADP-ribosylation.

name: Coagulation cascade initiation and amplification
rationale: All members describe the coagulation cascade's initiation and propagation, whereas confusables add factor VIII/IX defects, fibrinolysis or platelet degranulation.

name: Chorionic trophoblast and placental labyrinth development
rationale: Members concern chorionic trophoblast differentiation, proliferation and migration, chorio-allantoic fusion and labyrinth vascular branching, unlike confusables featuring trophoblast giant cells, endoreduplication and decidualization.

name: B cell gene modules with plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell and lymphocyte transcriptional modules plus plasma cell/immunoglobulin modules and plasma cell differentiation, whereas confusables add B cell surface signatures, germinal centre, ICOS and Tfh programmes.

name: HSF1 heat-shock response and suppression of p53-mediated apoptosis
rationale: Members combine HSF1 activation/attenuation and heat acclimation with regulation (mainly suppression) of p53-mediated intrinsic apoptosis and anoikis, whereas confusables add UPRmt, stress granules, acetylation or positive p53 apoptosis.

name: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron specification and patterning
rationale: Members concern dorsoventral patterning and motor neuron/interneuron specification in spinal cord and brainstem, unlike confusables on branchiomotor nerves, floor plate/neural plate or midbrain dopaminergic neurons.

name: TCA cycle with glutamine, glutamate and alanine interconversion
rationale: Members link the TCA cycle and its intermediates (2-oxoglutarate, malate, oxaloacetate, pyruvate) to glutamine, glutamate and alanine metabolism, whereas confusables add aspartate, the malate-aspartate shuttle, pyruvate transport or gluconeogenesis.

name: IL-6 and M-CSF signaling with ERK1/2 activation
rationale: Members share IL-6/JAK-STAT3 and CSF1 (M-CSF) receptor signalling via SHC to ERK1/2 and macrophage proliferation, while confusables add DAP12, SIRP interactions, myeloid identity or CSF production and differentiation.

name: Outflow tract, semilunar valve and cardiac artery morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern outflow tract septation, aortic/pulmonary valves, pharyngeal arch, pulmonary and coronary arteries and cardiac neural crest, unlike confusables on second heart field, AV valves/endocardial cushions or BMP-ductus physiology.

name: Integrin-fibronectin adhesion, cell spreading and stress fiber formation
rationale: Members share integrin/syndecan-matrix adhesion, fibronectin assembly, spreading, stress fibers and MET-FAK/tensin signalling, whereas confusables add collagen/TGFB, EMT, focal adhesion or ROCK/PAK modules.

name: SUMO processing, E1-E2 conjugation and target protein SUMOylation
rationale: Members cover the SUMO conjugation machinery (processing, E1/E2 transfer, desumoylation) and SUMOylation of diverse nuclear targets, while confusables add chromatin/replication targets, Ran mitosis or PML nuclear-transport roles.

name: CRH and corticosterone-driven stress and fear response
rationale: Members share the organismal stress response (CRH, corticosterone, fear, general adaptation syndrome), whereas confusables cover glucocorticoid secretion, other behaviors or neuropeptide/sleep signalling.

qualifier: mesendoderm, gut tube and lateral mesoderm
name: Gastrulation, mesendoderm specification and early gut and lateral mesoderm
rationale: Members span primitive streak, EMT and germ layer formation, endoderm/mesoderm specification, foregut/hindgut and lateral plate mesoderm with OCT4/SOX2/NANOG, unlike confusables on cardiogenesis/second heart field or left-right asymmetry.

name: MTF1-metallothionein metal response and ROS detoxification
rationale: Members combine responses to zinc, copper, manganese and iron via MTF1/metallothioneins with ROS detoxification and redox homeostasis, whereas confusables add cadmium/heavy metals, copper/manganese transport or NO/peroxide responses.

name: Lipid droplet turnover, triglyceride catabolism and fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation, fusion and disassembly, lipophagy, triglyceride breakdown and fatty acid uptake/oxidation, whereas confusables emphasise triglyceride and phospholipid biosynthesis, glycerol metabolism or lipase/PDE3B regulation.
